name: Countdown
what: A countdown: each number pops in and the ring around it drains over its step, a glow pulses on every change, the end word lands with a kick - or a number beside a line that shrinks.

learned_from.what: the number in a red ring on a dark glow, one a second
the number beside a red line that shrinks

motion: a number every 30 f: pop 8 f (scale 1.35 -> 1), the ring drains linearly, the glow pulses 12 f; the end word back.out 12 f
